text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
U-um, are you okay? It sounds like you
might be
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the famished growls of Wonder
Acute's
stomach, my colleague, Trainer
Kiryuin, can't help
but show concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hailing from a storied family of trainers,
she's
very straitlaced, yet kind at
heart—which is
exactly why she can't
look the other way.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You're looking rather thin as well...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer
<username>...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's quite right, dear. My debut bout
is coming
up, so I'm preparing for it in
my own way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry if I worried you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she may look unhealthy at a
glance, there's
actually nothing wrong
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as boxers cut weight in the lead-up
to a
fight, she's toning her physique by
restricting
food and drink to only what's
necessary before
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's Wonder Acute's preparation
method. She
may seem easygoing, but
deep down, she's as
tough as they come.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm... My body is in prime form, but I'm
not totally
focused yet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you be a dear and give me the
usual,
Trainer? Get me fired up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The usual. As always, Wonder Acute is
seeking an
extreme jolt of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: With some extra oomph, if you please.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwap, thwap, thwap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, th-thump, thwap!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Right there!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what on earth?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, th-thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! I'm ready
to rock
and roooll!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer
<username>...
That
seemed a little... rough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This "spirited" shoulder massage is what
gets
Wonder Acute into the right
mindset for racing.
And boy, is it
effective.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hah! Rrraaaghhh!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: She just ran off... Is that really okay too?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, r-right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that Wonder Acute got a little
too
psyched up, likely because it's her
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute! You need to get ahold
of
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, right you are. All righty, easy
does it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes both of us to finally get the
unruly
Wonder Acute under control. It
seems being at
the racecourse gets her
particularly worked up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's clear there's a strong fighting
spirit that
lies dormant within her. I'm
expecting good things
from her today.
